A negative length maps to 16384 and clamps to the available batch.
Comfy list-input semantics map to a typed image list.

Explicit migration covers all nine dynamic resize selections. Linked crop controls and unknown selections fail closed rather than changing behavior.
Imported center-fit uses centered fill, and divisibility is finalized by cropping after resize. The numeric crop value 0 is accepted as center.

Imported divisibility is finalized by cropping after resize. NVIDIA RTX VSR fails its closed interpolation transform; device controls source placement only. No-mask unpadded output is absent instead of a placeholder.
Disjoint offsets and zero-sized requests fail instead of returning an empty image. Other placements preserve the source's clipping and offsets.
The source derives one region per frame; native derives the union region and therefore preserves batching when frame bounds differ.
The supplied image must already match the mask dimensions. Its batch must equal the mask batch, or the mask must be a singleton.
Center crop maps to natural whole-pixel fill; odd crop margins may select a neighboring edge pixel.
Crops with no source overlap are rejected instead of returning an empty mask.
Shape size uses pixel-center geometry; even dimensions may differ by one edge pixel from Pillow's inclusive bounds.
Single-frame and reversed frame intervals use native defined endpoint behavior.
The custom font asset and word wrapping are replaced by Pillow's bundled font; text, placement, color, frame count, and rotation range are preserved.
Morphology and temporal controls are preserved; Gaussian blur remains float32 instead of the source's 8-bit Pillow round trip.
per_batch controls source chunking only and is removed.
The source rounds pixels to 8-bit before applying its per-channel threshold; native tolerance compares float pixels directly.
device controls source placement only and is removed.
Legacy BBOX tuples and BOUNDING_BOX records are normalized in source order. The shorter image or bounding-box batch determines the output batch.
Requires img_composite. Font assets, alignment, direction, background, shadow, and the separate mask output are not preserved.
PiDiNet is not translated because its bundled license requires separate permission for commercial use.
Scribble PiDiNet is not translated because its bundled license requires separate permission for commercial use.
Diffusion Edge is not translated because Dinkster does not provide its three large checkpoints and runtime-installed dependency path.

The native target makes seed zero deterministic instead of using process-global random state; nonzero JSON-safe seeds preserve the source flow. The source's uint64 seeds above the JSON-safe integer maximum require review.
The source resolution input is accepted but ignored by its detector.
The source wrapper declares resolution but does not pass it to the detector.
